| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Edge probability | Edge probability, Thin edges, Edge orientation | The edge probability from 0 to 1 as gray, the edges thinned to one pixel, or the direction of the edges from 0 to 180 degrees as gray. |
| **Thinning radius** `nmsRadius` | 2 | 1 to 10 px | How far across the edge the thinning looks for a stronger value. OpenCV uses 2. |
| **Border radius** `boundaryRadius` | 0 | 0 to 20 px | Edges this close to the image edge are removed. OpenCV uses 0. |
| **Thinning multiplier** `m` | 1 | 1 to 2 | A value must beat its neighbors across the edge times this to stay. OpenCV uses 1. |
